items: Fishing improved a little this afternoon: three grounds are GOOD again (Tara, Decabobo, Turda) as wind there dropped to about 3 kt. Fishing right now is 3 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 4 VERY POOR (was 0 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 3 POOR / 6 VERY POOR). Nangalao and Cabunlawan eased from VERY POOR to POOR (20 kt, gusts 26–27), and Culion eased to POOR but is hit by 1.3 kt current. Ciron, Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan stay VERY POOR (current 1.5–1.7 kt, or 21 kt wind at Ciron).

Regional wind: Wed 11 13 kt, gusts 20, Thu 12 14 kt, gusts 20, Fri 13 14 kt, gusts 20, Sat 14 11 kt (was 8.9), Sun 15 7.6 kt, Mon 16 12 kt, gusts 19, Tue 17 9.4 kt. Supply outlook is unchanged: Thu 12 and Fri 13 stay SOFT. Shortage detector ELEVATED Wed–Mon; surge OFF.
